title: Fix schematron rules silently skipping all checks due to namespace mismatch
body:
The schematron rules in `hdtSMP64.sch` never fired because their XPath expressions used unprefixed element names, which match elements in *no* namespace — but valid FSMP config files must declare `xmlns="FSMP-Validator"` (required by `targetNamespace` in the XSD), placing all elements in that namespace.

## Changes

- **`hdtSMP64.sch`**: Add `<sch:ns prefix="f" uri="FSMP-Validator"/>` and qualify all XPath expressions with `f:`:

```xml
<!-- Before: never matches namespace-qualified elements -->
<sch:rule context="bone[mass = '0']">
    <sch:assert test="not(inertia)" role="error">...</sch:assert>

<!-- After: correctly matches elements in the FSMP-Validator namespace -->
<sch:ns prefix="f" uri="FSMP-Validator"/>
<sch:rule context="f:bone[f:mass = '0']">
    <sch:assert test="not(f:inertia)" role="error">...</sch:assert>
```

This applies to both `f:bone` and `f:bone-default` rules, and all three assert tests (`inertia`, `linearDamping`, `angularDamping`).
